Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
ANVIL (apr...@ivory.trentu.ca) wrote:
: Okay, I think I've got the voting stuff down pat.

: Except for one thing,
: And this harks back to the original decks/cards/whatever...

: Can the Caitiff call votes?

Yup. As Camarilla vampires (just not in a clan) they can call most votes,
except those prohibited to them by card text (like those that require princes
or justicars if the caitiff weren't princes already). If Caitiff couldn't
vote, those weenie vote decks would get hosed, 'cuz those 1 capacity vamps
couldn't be princes...

: Cammie/Non-cammie?

Non-Camarilla vampires have much harsher restrictions on calling votes, such
as not being able to be princes, not being able to be named a Camarilla
Exemplary, etc. See LSJ compilation of the Dark Sovereigns rules/errata
for full details.

: I would think they couldn't,

: But then again, what the heck do I know...

-spongy
